1. Introduction 
Union Bank of India, a Public Sector Bank has its Head Office at 239, Vidhan Bhavan 
Marg, Union Bank Bhavan, Nariman Point, Mumbai – 400021, having Department of 
Information Technology at 1/1A, Adi Shankaracharya Marg, opp. Powai Lake, 
Powai, Andheri East, Mumbai-400072.The Bank has 9400+ branches, 18 Field 
General Manager’s offices and 125 regional offices spread across the country. 
2. Definition 
 
2.1. ‘Bank or UBI’ means unless excluded by and repugnant context or the meaning 
thereof, shall mean ‘Union Bank of India’, described in more detail in clause 1 
above and which has invited bids under this Request for Information and shall 
be deemed to include it successors and permitted assigns. 
 
2.2. ‘RFI’ means this Request for Information document prepared by Union Bank of 
India requesting bidders for providing scope of work, technical details, 
tentative cost i.e. Bill of Material and costing model for subscribing IaaS 
/PaaS/SaaS on VMware Cloud on any CSP Infrastructure for hosting Banking 
applications. 
 
2.3. ‘Bidder’ means a vendor who is submitting the proposal in response to this RFI. 
 
2.4. ‘Proposal’ means that Technical proposal including any documents submitted 
by the bidder as per asked in this RFI. 
 
2.5. ‘Solution’ means providing services for complete scope of work, technical 
details, tentative cost and costing model for subscribing IaaS /PaaS/SaaS on 
VMware Cloud on any CSP Infrastructure for hosting Banking applications. 
 
3. Objectives of RFI 
 
Bank has hosted various Banking applications which are critical and non-critical in 
nature on Bank’s On-Private Cloud Infrastructure which is built on VMware Private 
Cloud Suite. Now Bank is in process of adoption of public cloud/Hybrid cloud 
infrastructure for hosting the applications as and when such requirement arises. 
Bank is inviting the technical proposal from the interested cloud service provider’s 
authorized partner though this RFI. The interested partner needs to submit the 
complete scope of work, deliverables, technical details, tentative cost and costing 
model and other relevant details and information for the CSPs infrastructure like 
security and network architecture, infrastructure details etc for hosting Banking 
applications. 
Bank will draft an RFP based on the technical details, scope of work and other 
details submitted by the managed service partner (MSP) for the CSP’s 
infrastructure.

5.1. Managed Service Provider must submit an authorization letter from the Cloud 
Service Provider authorizing to participate in this RFI. (Authorization letter 
must be on CSP’s letter head and duly signed by authorized signatory)

black listed by any of Government Authority or Public Sector Undertaking (PSUs). 
The bidder shall give an undertaking (on their letter head) that they have not 
been black listed by any of the Govt. Authority or PSUs. In case, in the past, the 
name of their Company was black listed by any of the Govt. Authority or PSUs, 
the same must have been removed from the black list as on date of submission 
of the tender, otherwise the bid will not be considered. Undertaking on 
Company’s letterhead as per Annexure B to be submitted by the bidder. 
 
Note: Bank Shall Follow Govt Guidelines/Notifications for Public Procurement. 
As per Policy Circular No.1(2)(1)/2016-MA dated 10.03.2016 issued by GOI and 
F.20/2/2014-PPD (Pt) dated 20.09.2016, bank may relax condition of prior 
turnover and prior experience with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises and 
Startups subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications. 
 
6. Tentative Scope of Work for RFI 
 
Bank is in process of adopting public cloud platform for hosting Banking 
applications. Bank has built On-Premise Private Cloud Infrastructure for hosting 
workloads on VMware Private Cloud Suite. Bank will adopt Hybrid Cloud model

initially for hosting Banking applications. During this adoption phase, Bank will 
leverage and understand the Public Cloud platform, costing model and its 
associated various technologies. 
In order to finalize the scope of work, Bank need to get detailed information in 
below mention area but not limited to the following: 
6.1. 
Cloud readiness Assessments 
Interested partners should provide complete details regarding framework, 
methodologies, areas covered, deliverables associated and redesigning of 
client model for cloud readiness assessments. 
6.2. Workload Migration Planning 
Interested partners should describe about migration option (rehost, refactor, 
rewrite), migration planning, migration testing, tools used to analyze and 
plan migration etc. 
6.3. Provisioning, Orchestration and Automation 
Describe the overview of managed services for creation, deletion, 
modification and orchestration of cloud assets. 
6.4. Monitoring and Analytics 
Interested partners should specify the services to track and report about the 
availability, health and performance of deployed infrastructure. Leveraging 
monitoring and analytic capabilities to initiate self-healing & automation. 
Describe recent success with the last 1 year 
6.5. Capacity Optimization 
Partners should describe the services to optimize the use of cloud capacity 
to support reliable and cost-efficient operations. Services should include 
aspects of capacity planning and demand management in addition to 
optimization of existing capacity. 
6.6. 
Cost Monitoring 
Partners should describe compete costing model, how cloud service providers 
charges for the offered services, also about the existing capabilities for 
monitoring cloud cost, including availability of metering functionality. Also 
describe about customer live access to current and historical information and 
alerting functionality offered. Specify the measures to be taken by the bank 
for cost optimization. 
 
6.7. 
Backup and Recovery 
Partner should describe about the backup services related to protecting data 
of the Bank, including the granularity of backup and availability of recovery 
options. 
6.8. Disaster Recovery 
 Partner should describe the services offered for disaster recovery, self 
service capabilities and the RPO and RTO service levels associated with CSP’s.

8 | 21 
 
6.9. Configuration Management 
 Partners should describe about services to ensure and maintain configuration 
standard. Services should be capable to prevent, detect and remediate 
changes in the configuration of the cloud environment. Also include policy-
based controls, actionable events, automated workflows and associated 
reporting. 
6.10. Securing the Cloud Environment 
 Partners should provide the details of services to protect cloud environment 
from security threats. Partners should provide complete IT Security Services 
offered by the CSP’s and how Bank can avail those services to secure their 
environment. 
6.11 Hybrid Management, and Customer Infrastructure Integration Services 
Partners should provide the extent to which management capabilities are 
provided to address customers hybrid requirements, identity and access 
management solutions, workloads and infrastructure in On-Premise and 
hosted solutions, customer wide area network etc. 
6.12 Cloud Provider technical support 
Partners should describe about any implication that using your managed 
services has on customer’s ability to directly engaged with the CSP’s. Support 
agreement between MSP & CSP to ensure 2nd and 3rd tier incident and 
support resolution and any other agreements that you have. 
6.13 Cloud Service Providers Platform 
Interested Cloud Service Provider’s partners should provide complete details 
of the CSP’s platform and various services offered by the CSP. 
6.14 Cloud Management Platform 
 Provide a high-level overview description of the cloud management platform 
and/or integrated tooling used to deliver services. Include narrative that 
helps explain which CMP components are provided by third parties. 
6.15 Networking 
 The interested partner should provide the complete network details and 
networking requirement (how data flow within the CSP, network connection 
between CSP and Bank Premises, network diagram etc.) for the Bank, for 
onboarding the applications on the CSP’s platform. 
6.16 Log Analysis 
Partners should provide the process how various logs are stored, Secured and 
analyzed based on the Bank’s requirements. 
6.17 Accreditations/Certification and Business Profile 
 Partners should provide the details of Accreditations/Certifications of 
Cloud Server Provider. The complete business profile of the CSPs like how 
long in cloud service business, core strength of CSP in cloud services.

9 | 21 
 
6.18 Landing Zone 
 Interested partners should provide complete details and design for landing 
zone creation with estimated cost and time involved. 
6.19 Approach of onboarding of new clients 
 Describe the approach taken and complete customized process required to 
onboard a new client on Public/Hybrid Cloud as per Bank requirement. 
6.20 
Regulatory authorities guide lines 
 Cloud Service Provider’s should ensure the compliance with the guidelines 
and relevant certifications issued by RBI, Ministry of Electronic and 
Information Technology (Meity), PCI-DSS, Cert-IN, ISO etc, and confirm that 
the Bank’ data will reside in Data Centers base in India. 
6.21 
Exit clause 
 Partners should provide the detailed description of the exit clause including 
agreed process and turnaround time for exit, data completeness and 
portability, secure purge of Bank’s information, smooth transition of 
services, monitoring the ongoing design of application and service delivery 
technology stack the exit plans align with and details of how cloud hosted 
services and data will moved out from the cloud with minimal impact on 
continuity of the Bank’s business.

2. Definition 
 
2.1. ‘Bank or UBI’ means unless excluded by and repugnant context or the meaning 
thereof, shall mean ‘Union Bank of India’, described in more detail in clause 1 
above and which has invited bids under this Request for Information and shall 
be deemed to include it successors and permitted assigns. 
 
2.2. ‘RFI’ means this Request for Information document prepared by Union Bank of 
India requesting bidders for providing scope of work, technical details, 
tentative cost i.e. Bill of Material and costing model for subscribing IaaS

applications.

by the bidder as per asked in this RFI. 
 
2.5. ‘Solution’ means providing services for complete scope of work, technical 
details, tentative cost and costing model for subscribing IaaS /PaaS/SaaS on 
VMware Cloud on any CSP Infrastructure for hosting Banking applications. 
 
3. Objectives of RFI 
 
Bank has hosted various Banking applications which are critical and non-critical in 
nature on Bank’s On-Private Cloud Infrastructure which is built on VMware Private 
Cloud Suite. Now Bank is in process of adoption of public cloud/Hybrid cloud 
infrastructure for hosting the applications as and when such requirement arises. 
Bank is inviting the technical proposal from the interested cloud service provider’s 
authorized partner though this RFI. The interested partner needs to submit the 
complete scope of work, deliverables, technical details, tentative cost and costing 
model and other relevant details and information for the CSPs infrastructure like 
security and network architecture, infrastructure details etc for hosting Banking 
applications. 
Bank will draft an RFP based on the technical details, scope of work and other 
details submitted by the managed service partner (MSP) for the CSP’s 
infrastructure.

Bank invites proposal from the eligible entities to submit the complete scope of 
work, technical details, tentative cost and costing model and other relevant details 
and information for the CSPs infrastructure like security and network architecture, 
infrastructure details etc for subscribing Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) on 
VMware Cloud on any CSP Infrastructure for hosting Banking applications. 
No contractual obligation on behalf of the Bank whatsoever shall arise from the 
RFI process unless and until a formal contract is signed & executed by duly 
authorized officers of the Bank and the successful bidder. 
Bidders are expected to examine all instructions, forms, terms, specifications, 
and other information in the RFI document. The procedure and terms & 
conditions for submission of bid are enumerated in this RFI. 
Proposed public/Hybrid cloud offerings should be complied with RBI & MEITY 
recommendations.

turnover and prior experience with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises and

6. Tentative Scope of Work for RFI 
 
Bank is in process of adopting public cloud platform for hosting Banking 
applications. Bank has built On-Premise Private Cloud Infrastructure for hosting 
workloads on VMware Private Cloud Suite. Bank will adopt Hybrid Cloud model

7 | 21 
 
initially for hosting Banking applications. During this adoption phase, Bank will 
leverage and understand the Public Cloud platform, costing model and its 
associated various technologies. 
In order to finalize the scope of work, Bank need to get detailed information in 
below mention area but not limited to the following: 
6.1. 
Cloud readiness Assessments 
Interested partners should provide complete details regarding framework, 
methodologies, areas covered, deliverables associated and redesigning of 
client model for cloud readiness assessments. 
6.2. Workload Migration Planning 
Interested partners should describe about migration option (rehost, refactor, 
rewrite), migration planning, migration testing, tools used to analyze and 
plan migration etc. 
6.3. Provisioning, Orchestration and Automation 
Describe the overview of managed services for creation, deletion, 
modification and orchestration of cloud assets. 
6.4. Monitoring and Analytics 
Interested partners should specify the services to track and report about the 
availability, health and performance of deployed infrastructure. Leveraging 
monitoring and analytic capabilities to initiate self-healing & automation. 
Describe recent success with the last 1 year 
6.5. Capacity Optimization 
Partners should describe the services to optimize the use of cloud capacity 
to support reliable and cost-efficient operations. Services should include 
aspects of capacity planning and demand management in addition to 
optimization of existing capacity. 
6.6. 
Cost Monitoring 
Partners should describe compete costing model, how cloud service providers 
charges for the offered services, also about the existing capabilities for 
monitoring cloud cost, including availability of metering functionality. Also 
describe about customer live access to current and historical information and 
alerting functionality offered. Specify the measures to be taken by the bank 
for cost optimization. 
 
6.7. 
Backup and Recovery 
Partner should describe about the backup services related to protecting data 
of the Bank, including the granularity of backup and availability of recovery 
options. 
6.8. Disaster Recovery 
 Partner should describe the services offered for disaster recovery, self
